constraints: Native Windows only; fresh editable snapshot and up-to-date all_source. Unchanged scratch control ELF must reproduce production byte-for-byte. All other ordered inputs including automatic data remain unchanged; selected trials are labelled separately.

PASS means experiment completion, not successful trial linkage or boot. Inspect the trial exit_code and ELF. Truncated diagnostics are lower bounds; retained autogenerated and fallback inputs preclude complete-source claims.

Refuses changed inventories and unsafe outputs; selected names must identify distinct unfinished configured TUs. Optional --max-errors 1000 may still hit the native linker hard cap. No production source/config/link output edits.
name: r67-runtime-allsource-probe
purpose: Bounded actual full-image editable link experiment using all configured source objects or an explicitly selected subset
usage: After configure.py --non-matching, ninja -j2, and ninja -j2 all_source: --out build/r67_runtime_allsource.json; repeat --unit game/path to test a selected unfinished subset instead.
